definitions.explanation: Not often; used with negative verb forms to indicate that something happens infrequently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧は{滅多|めった}に⟦{怒|おこ}らない→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧は{滅多|めった}に⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
{滅多|めった}に⟦{外食|がいしょく}→外食：03024_gaishoku⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{滅多|めった}に is almost always used with negative verbs (〜ない) to express that something rarely or seldom happens. It emphasizes the exceptional rarity of the action.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {滅多|めった}に + negative verb: rarely does ~
- {滅多|めった}にない: is rare, seldom occurs
- {滅多|めった}にないこと: a rare occurrence

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- {滅多|めった}に⟦{怒|おこ}らない→怒る：00876_okoru⟧ (rarely gets angry)
- {滅多|めった}に⟦{外食|がいしょく}→外食：03024_gaishoku⟧しない (rarely eats out)
- {滅多|めった}に⟦{会|あ}えない→会う：00482_au⟧ (can rarely meet)
- ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧は{滅多|めった}にない (such an opportunity is rare)

FREQUENCY SCALE (with negative):
- ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧〜ない: not very often (mild)
- {滅多|めった}に〜ない: rarely, seldom (strong)
- ⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧〜ない: hardly ever, almost never (very strong)
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧〜ない: not at all (absolute)

USAGE:
Also written as めったに in hiragana. Can occasionally appear without negative in the related form {滅多|めった}な: {滅多|めった}なことでは〜ない (not under ordinary circumstances).
